title: Shared Data Strategy
goal: Pick the zero-allocation approach for processing stack data across spawned threads.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Scoped Threads

hints: `thread::scope` guarantees spawned threads join before exiting, permitting references to stack variables without cloning.
explanation: `thread::scope` guarantees child threads finish before the scope returns, allowing elements from data to be safely borrowed without allocations or clones. Standard `thread::spawn` fails to compile when borrowing stack data because it requires 'static ownership. Using move on multiple standard spawns transfers ownership on the first thread, making subsequent moves invalid.
